Hello Jonas / Lena,

Thanks for the details and the trace. I reviewed the invite token CS-1129037 and confirm the link is pointing to tenant alias "redwood-vendors" but the vendor lookup is resolving to vendor_id 674211 which is currently attached to an existing external organization record named "Stella Technologies LLC" (note the slight name difference).

Root cause hypothesis: There is a duplicate vendor record in our system (StellaTech vs Stella Technologies LLC) with overlapping identifiers. The invite flow routes to the existing record which causes the redirect/claimed-account message.

We can do either:
1) Remap the invite token to the new vendor_id (we will need written authorization from Redwood to reassign the invite to vendor_id X)
2) Merge the vendor records (will require vendor-side confirmation and additional data: legal name, Tax ID, DUNS)

To proceed we need:
- Written approval from Redwood to remap/merge (please include the Coupa Support ticket ID)
- The preferred vendor legal name and Tax ID from StellaTech

If you prefer, we can perform a temporary manual activation so Lena can accept the PO while the records are reconciled. That is a one-time action and requires Redwood to confirm the request.

Let us know how you want to proceed and we’ll take the needed action.

Regards,
